A.explanation: Charm is one of the six quark flavours, with charge $+2/3e$.

B.explanation: A meson is a hadron made of a quark and an antiquark, not a flavour of quark.

C.explanation: Strange is one of the six quark flavours, with charge $-1/3e$.

D.explanation: Up is one of the six quark flavours, found in protons and neutrons.

hints: Notice the question asks for a quark flavour, which is the name given to each type of quark.
Recall the six quark flavours: up, down, strange, charm, top and bottom.
Think about what a meson is made from and whether it is a fundamental quark type or a composite hadron.
walkthrough: List what flavour means for quarks: it is the name for the six different types of quark.
Recall the six flavours as up, down, strange, charm, top and bottom.
Check charm, strange and up against that list - all three appear in the list of flavours.
Recall that a meson is a composite hadron consisting of one quark and one antiquark, such as a pion or kaon.
Since a meson is a particle made from quarks and not a type of quark itself, it is not a flavour. This is option B.
